title: WaterColor "Attitude Adjustment" 45 Watercolor Blvd W #103
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: *Per Watercolor HOA, please include all guests aged 5 and older in your total count of adult guests to receive amenity and pool access wristbands. Sleep arrangements are provided as a courtesy and are not considered in the occupancy count.**This home is allowed 6 amenity access bands.**- 2 adult bikes provided- Directly across from Cerulean Park- Fully remodeled 2024- Washer/Dryer- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutAttitude Adjustment is a 2-bedroom, 3-bathroom condo that sleeps 6 in the heart of WaterColor—the best of 30A living! The sunny neighborhood provides access to multiple community pools and is close to several beach accesses, including the private beach club in main WaterColor. Guests will love this newly remodeled condo (2024), beautiful screened-in porch with brand new patio furniture, and breathtaking views from the second-floor covered balcony. It's the perfect combination of convenience, comfort, and style.The first floor of this beautiful 2-story condo was made for rest and relaxation, boasting 2 bedrooms and a bonus twin over twin bunk room. The primary king bedroom has plenty of space to unwind and boasts a large Smart TV as well as a screened-in porch with brand new patio seating. A stunning second-floor great room welcomes guests in with warm wood flooring and plenty of natural light for a bright, airy feeling. The living area makes for a relaxing space with a large sectional couch, oversized armchair, and new large Smart TV perfect for a movie night! From the door in the living area, step out onto the covered balcony and enjoy views of the park while relaxing in comfortable outdoor furnishings. Inside, the dining table seats 6, while the adjacent kitchen, complete with GE appliances and designer cabinets, provides 3 additional seats at the large kitchen island with marble countertops. A newly remodeled bathroom and bonus room with built-in twin-over-twin bunk beds are nestled beyond the kitchen. Plus, there's a laundry closet on this floor for added convenience.Attitude Adjustment makes the perfect retreat for friends and family to gather and be entertained. Use the Van Ness Butler and Santa Clara beach accesses to enjoy fun in the sun, ride on the bike paths with the 2 adult bikes provided with your stay, or relax on the balcony and enjoy the views. No need for an Attitude Adjustment when staying here! SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 6):FIRST FLOOR: -Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Walk In Shower-Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo-1st floor Bonus Room: Twin over Twin Bunk-2nd floor Bonus Room: Twin over Twin Bunk with Shared Bathroom and Shower*Watercolor Community HOA prohibits the rental of Low-Speed Vehicles for guests staying in the Town Center.
